title: Kissed Caramel Argentinian Beef Roast
description: A romantic Argentinian dish featuring caramel and a soffritto base, perfect for a special occasion. This raw-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the beef roast to the pot and sear on all sides until browned.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, brush the caramel sauce over the beef roast.
Return the pot to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the beef rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Slice the beef against the grain and serve with the roasted vegetables and caramel sauce.
